ns2:section.sectionText: This section is a placeholder, and cannot be registered. To register for a section with a specific faculty member, please contact them first for permission. If they approve, please email stat-courses@illinois.edu (CCing the instructor) with your name and UIN, and you will be provided with the CRN to add. Registering for this course without instructor approval can result in a failing grade. For general Statistics course registration information: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration
